blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: This paper demonstrate that whether masking-based token pruning helps or hurts worst-group robustness can be predicted before deployment, without labels or fine-tuning. A systematic study of semantic masking across 8 spurious-correlation benchmarks shows its effect on worst-group accuracy is highly unstable: it improves accuracy by up to 82.5% relative on some datasets and degrades it by up to 100% on others. We trace this instability to spurious inversion: background patches receive higher CLIP text-similarity than the true object when the spurious attribute is background-separable, inverting the assumption every text- and attention-guided pruning method relies on. We introduce the Spurious Inversion Metric (SIM), a label-free, pre-deployment diagnostic whose sign predicts this effect with statistical significance (binomial p = 0.035 p=0.035 ) across all 8 datasets, and remains dependable across 6 CLIP architectures with a clean foreground/background split. Naive masking is itself a major source of risk: it causes the largest average-accuracy loss of any method we evaluate, and its own per-image segmentation step is a significant runtime bottleneck. To address this, we design a batched, synchronization-free GPU segmentation routine that cuts this overhead from 3.5 × \times to 1.75 × \times baseline. Gating deployment by SIM’s sign recovers masking’s benefits while avoiding its worst failures, matching or exceeding a strong pruning baseline on 7 of 8 datasets.
blocks.zh: 本文表明,在部署之前,可以预测基于面具的代币钻探是否有助于或伤害最坏组稳健性,而无需标签或微调. 对8个假阴阳关系基准的语义遮掩的系统研究表明,其对最差组精度的影响非常不稳定:它使一些数据集的精度相对提高高达82.5%,其他数据集的精度降低高达100%. 我们追踪这种不稳定性到虚假的倒置:背景补丁得到的CLIP文本比真实对象更相似,当虚假的属性是背景分离时,颠倒每个文本和注意力引导的调试方法所依赖的假设. 我们引入了无标签的部署前诊断(SIM),其标志在所有8个数据集中都预示着这种具有统计意义的效应(binomial p = 0.035 p = 0.035),在6个CLIP架构中仍可信赖,具有干净的前缘/后缘分裂. 直觉蒙面本身就是一个主要的风险来源:它对我们评估的任何方法造成了最大的平均准确性损失,它自己的逐象分解步骤是一个重要的运行时瓶颈. 为了解决这个问题,我们设计了一个批量的,无同步的GPU分块程序,将这一间接费用从3.5×时削减到1.75×时基线. 用SIM的标志进行部署可以恢复遮掩的好处,同时避免最糟糕的失败,匹配或超过8个数据集中的7个的坚固基线。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training) [ 1 ] and other contrastively pretrained image-text models now underlie image classification and retrieval systems deployed under real compute budgets. Token pruning is among the most direct routes to compressing them: dropping a fraction of a vision transformer’s patch tokens before the transformer body reduces quadratic attention cost, with only a modest drop in clean accuracy. Prior work has approached this through attention-based pruning at an intermediate layer [ 2 ] , token merging and fusion [ 3 ] , and learned importance scores [ 9 ] , typically evaluated on clean, in-distribution accuracy alone. A parallel line of work targets a different goal: not efficiency, but robustness. The spurious-correlation literature [ 4 ] has established that a model’s errors are often driven by non-causal background context rather than the object itself, with Waterbirds [ 4 ] and CelebA [ 5 ] as standard benchmarks, later extended by UrbanCars [ 6 ] , MetaShifts [ 7 ] , and ImageNet-9 [ 8 ] . Semantic masking , zeroing out image regions identified as background before encoding, is a natural response: removing the background should also remove the model’s reliance on it.
blocks.zh: CLIP(语言-图像预培训)[1]和其他具有对比性的预先训练的图像文本模型,现在成为实际计算预算下部署的图像分类和检索系统的基础。 Token pruning是压缩它们最直接的路径之一:在变压器机体降低四极注意成本之前,投放一小部分视觉变压器的补丁符号,而纯度仅略微下降. 以往的工作是通过在中间层进行基于注意力的挤压、象征性的合并和聚变[3],以及学到的重要性分数[9],通常仅根据清洁的、分散的准确性来评价。 平行的工作方针目标不同:不是效率,而是稳健。 虚构的-correction文献[4] 证实模型的错误往往由非原因背景背景驱动,而不是对象本身,水鸟[4]和CelebA[5]作为标准基准,后来由UrbanCars[6],MetaShifts[7]和ImageNet-9[8]扩展. 语义遮掩(semantic masking),在编码前将被确定为背景的图像区域零化,是一种自然反应:移除背景也应该消除模型对它的依赖.

blocks.en: None of the pruning methods above target worst-group robustness, and none of the masking methods above target efficiency. Because masking also reduces the number of tokens that must be processed, it is natural to ask whether a single mechanism can deliver both at once. We call our own construction MARS (Masking And Reduction for Spurious-correlation robustness): it segments each image into foreground and background without supervision, masks out the background pixels, and prunes the remaining tokens. As far as we know, no prior published method combines unsupervised segmentation with pixel-level masking and evaluates it for worst-group robustness on CLIP; MARS is built to test this premise directly, not a reproduction of an existing technique.
blocks.zh: 超过目标最差组稳健度的冲刷方法没有一种,高于目标效率的遮掩方法也没有一种. 因为遮掩也减少了必须处理的符号数量,所以自然会问一个单一的机制是否能够同时交付两者. 我们称自己的建筑MARS(Masking and Reduction for Sureous-correction strongness):它将每个图像分解为前方和背景,没有监督,遮蔽了背景像素,并刷刷了剩下的符号. 据我们所知,没有之前公布的方法将不受监督的分割与像素级的遮掩相结合,并评价其在CLIP上最糟糕的组稳健性;MARS是用来直接测试这个前提的,而不是对现有技术的复制.

blocks.en: Effective use of masking as a compression mechanism entails two core challenges: (1) its effect on worst-group accuracy must be predictable before deployment, since masking can substantially degrade accuracy, and (2) any mechanism used to make this prediction, or to apply masking itself, must be efficient enough that its overhead does not offset the compression it delivers. We show that this combination is not free, and that its failure mode is silent. Across 8 standard spurious-correlation benchmarks, a representative semantic masking method (mask, then prune to half the tokens) improves worst-group accuracy by as much as 82.5% relative on UrbanCars and 25.6% on Waterbirds, while degrading it by 70.0% relative on ImageNet-9 and 39.7% on MetaShifts. There is no signal at inference time that distinguishes these two regimes: the method is applied identically, and only the eventual worst-group evaluation reveals which outcome occurred. For a paradigm centered on deploying compact models into regulated or safety-relevant settings, an intervention whose sign is unknown in advance is a liability rather than a solution.
blocks.zh: 有效使用遮盖作为压缩机制,需要两个核心挑战:(1)对最差组精度的影响在部署前必须是可预测的,因为遮盖可以大大降低精度;(2)用于作出这种预测或自我应用遮盖的任何机制必须足够高效,其间接费用不能抵消其提供的压缩. 我们显示这种组合不是免费的,它的失败模式是沉默的. 在8个标准虚伪-血脉关系基准中,一种有代表性的语义遮盖方法(任务,然后将半个令牌)提高了最差组的精度,在UrbanCars上比82.5%,在Waterbirds上比25.6%,而在ImageNet-9上比70.0%,在MetaShifts上比39.7%。 推论时没有信号能区分这两种制度:方法同样适用,只有最终最坏的组别评价能揭示结果. 对于一个以将紧凑模式部署到受管制或安全相关环境为核心的模式,事先未知标志的干预是一种责任而不是解决办法。

blocks.en: We locate the source of this instability in a specific, measurable property of CLIP’s joint embedding space: on datasets where the spurious attribute is a separable background region, background patches have higher cosine similarity to a generic class-level text prompt than the patches covering the true object, inverting the assumption every text- or attention-guided pruning method relies on (higher text-relevance as evidence for the object). We call this spurious inversion : a measurable, dataset-conditional signal, not a property of one benchmark.
blocks.zh: 我们在CLIP联合嵌入空间的特定、可测量属性中找到这种不稳定的来源:在假属性为可分离背景区域的数据集上,背景补丁与覆盖真实对象的补丁相比,具有比一般类级文本更相似的余弦性,颠倒了每个文本或注意力制导的穿插方法所依赖的假设(作为对象证据的文本相关性更高). 我们称之为这种虚假的倒置:一个可测量的、数据集条件的信号,而不是一个基准的属性。

blocks.en: Because the underlying quantity (per-patch text similarity, split by an unsupervised foreground/background segmentation) requires no downstream task label and no model evaluation, it can be computed for any candidate deployment dataset before a single classification is scored. We formalize this as the Spurious Inversion Metric (SIM): a diagnostic, not a corrective mechanism, that tells a practitioner in advance whether masking is likely to help or hurt on their data. Section 3 makes this precise: our implementation samples images according to the same group structure (label × \times spurious attribute) worst-group evaluation itself uses, so it presumes that structure is known, though it needs neither correctness labels nor a trained classifier.
blocks.zh: 由于基础数量(每幅文字相似性,由无监督的前地/后地分块分割)不需要下游任务标签,也没有模型评价,因此在获得单一分类之前,可以计算出任何候选部署数据集. 我们把它正式化为 " 纯洁的反省度量衡 " :一种诊断,而不是一种矫正机制,它事先告诉一名从业者面具是否会帮助或伤害他们的数据。 第3节给出了这一精确性:我们的执行图像根据相同的组结构(label ×\times 假属性)进行最差组评价本身,因此它假定该结构是已知的,尽管它既不需要正确的标签,也不需要训练有素的分类器.

blocks.en: Contributions. (1) We document spurious inversion, a measurable, mechanistically grounded property of CLIP representations, distinct from the known fact that attention alone is a biased importance signal. (2) We introduce SIM, a diagnostic requiring no downstream task label and no model evaluation, whose sign predicts the direction of masking’s effect on worst-group accuracy with statistical significance across 8 datasets (binomial p = 0.035 p=0.035 ; Spearman ρ = 0.78 \rho=0.78 ). (3) We show gating deployment by SIM’s sign matches or exceeds blind masking on every dataset, and a strong fixed pruning baseline on all but the one dataset where SIM’s blind spot misfires, recovering most of masking’s benefit without most of its worst failures. (4) We extend the analysis to 6 CLIP variants and characterize where the diagnostic holds and where it does not: dependable with a clean foreground/background separation, with a specific, reproducible blind spot on multi-context spurious structure (MetaShifts), which we report rather than obscure. (5) We separate two costs prior framings of masking-based compression conflate: SIM is a dataset-level diagnostic amortized to zero at inference time, while MARS’s own segmentation step is a genuine per-inference cost; we document two unsuccessful attempts to remove this cost and one that succeeds, reducing MARS’s overhead from 3.5 × \times to roughly 1.75 × \times baseline and leaving the remaining gap as an explicit open problem.
blocks.zh: 捐款。 (1) 我们记录了虚假的反演,一种可衡量、机械化的CLIP代表财产,不同于一个众所周知的事实,即仅仅关注就是一个有偏见的重要信号。 (2)我们引入了SIM,这个诊断不需要下游任务标签和模型评价,其标志预测了遮掩作用对8个数据集具有统计意义的最差组精度的影响方向(binomial p = 0.035 p = 0.035;Spearman ^ = 0.78\rho = 0.78). (3) 我们显示SIM的标志匹配或超过每个数据集的盲目遮盖的部署,以及除了SIM盲点误射的一个数据集外,所有其他数据集都有牢固的固定遮盖基线,在没有大多数最糟糕的故障的情况下恢复大部分遮盖的好处。 (4) 我们把分析扩大到6个CLIP变体,并描述诊断存在哪些地方和不存在:可依赖清洁的前地/后地分离,在多文字的虚假结构(MetaShifts)上有一个具体、可复制的盲点,我们报告而不是模糊。 (5) 我们分开了前两个基于遮掩的压缩拼接框架的成本:SIM是一个数据集层面的诊断分期摊还到推算时为零,而MARS自己的分期步骤是一个真正的推算成本;我们记录了两次试图去除这一成本的失败尝试和一次成功的尝试,将MARS的间接费用从3.5xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Token pruning for efficient vision transformers. FastV [ 2 ] prunes tokens by attention magnitude at an intermediate layer, EViT [ 3 ] reorganizes and fuses low-attention tokens into the class token, and PACT [ 9 ] combines attention-based pruning with clustering-based merging, all evaluated on clean or downstream accuracy, not worst-group robustness. ATP [ 17 ] reports attention-guided pruning can suppress spurious features under visual corruption, though this observation is preliminary and dataset-specific. Our compression-risk analysis (Section 5.1 ) is, to our knowledge, the first systematic evaluation of pruning’s effect on worst-group robustness across many datasets and methods at once.
blocks.zh: 为高效的视觉变压器敲门 FastV [2]按中层的注意量推算出信使,EViT [3]将低注意度信使重组并引信入类信使,PACT [9] 将基于注意力的信使与基于集群的合并相结合,均以干净或下游的准确性评价,而非最差的组稳性. ATP [17] 报告说,注意力制导的搜索可以压制视觉腐败下的假象特征,尽管这一观察是初步的和针对数据集的. 据我们所知,我们的压缩-风险分析(第5.1节)是一次系统评估,它涉及许多数据集和方法对最坏组稳健性的影响。

blocks.en: Spurious correlations and worst-group robustness. Waterbirds [ 4 ] and CelebA [ 5 ] , the latter adopted for group-robustness evaluation with the group splits from [ 4 ] , established worst-group accuracy as the standard metric for spurious-attribute reliance, later extended by UrbanCars [ 6 ] , MetaShifts [ 7 ] , and background-manipulation benchmarks such as ImageNet-9 [ 8 ] and ImageNet-D [ 15 ] ; a recent survey [ 16 ] situates these within the broader landscape of spurious correlations across machine learning. A separate line of work addresses spurious correlations directly through masking or attention-reweighting informed by unsupervised segmentation; our contribution is complementary: rather than proposing a new masking mechanism, we characterize when an existing one should or should not be trusted, using a diagnostic that needs no downstream task label and no additional model evaluation beyond what the segmentation step already computes.
blocks.zh: 纯粹的关联 和最坏的团体强健。 水鸟[4]和CelebA[5],后者采用组合-活性评价方法,将组合从[4]中分离出来,确定最坏组合的准确性,作为对虚假属性依赖的标准衡量标准,后来又由UrbanCars[6],MetaShifts[7]以及ImageNet-9[8]和ImageNet-D[15]等背景管理基准加以扩展;最近的一项调查[16]将这些要素置于机器学习中虚假关联的更广泛视野中。 单独的一行工作直接通过蒙蔽或未经监督的分块法使注意力重新加权,处理虚假的关联;我们的贡献是相辅相成的:我们不是提出一个新的遮掩机制,而是描述何时应该或不应该相信现有的一个机制,使用不需要下游任务标签的诊断,除了分块法已经计算出来的步骤之外,不需要额外的模型评价。

blocks.en: CLIP robustness diagnostics. Prior work has noted that CLIP’s attention is biased toward image regions correlated with, but not necessarily causally responsible for, the predicted label. Recent work corrects this bias directly, either by searching over prompts to reduce reliance on spurious multimodal cues [ 18 ] or by locating and editing the specific attention heads responsible for it [ 19 ] . Our finding is a distinct and more specific claim: it is not attention alone that is biased, but the text-similarity signal itself that inverts, in a way that is measurable per-dataset without labels and predicts a specific downstream failure mode.
blocks.zh: CLIP强力诊断. 先前的工作已经指出,CLIP的注意力偏重于与预测标签相关但不一定因果责任的图像区域. 近期的工作直接纠正了这种偏见,要么通过搜索提示来减少对虚假的多式联运提示的依赖[18],要么通过查找和编辑负责该提示的主管[19]。 我们的发现是一个不同且更具体的说法:不光是注意力是偏颇的,而是文本的相似性信号本身颠倒了,其方式是可以衡量的每个数据集没有标签,并预测具体的下游故障模式。

blocks.en: 3 Spurious Inversion and the SIM Diagnostic
blocks.zh: 3 纯粹的反演和SIM诊断

blocks.en: Setup. We build on OpenCLIP ViT-L/14 ( laion2b_s32b_b82k ), which tokenizes a 224 × 224 224\times 224 image into a 16 × 16 16\times 16 grid of 256 patch tokens. For a given image, we compute a foreground/background partition using PCA (3 components) on the patch embeddings, a Gaussian smoothing pass over the resulting spatial grid ( σ = 0.72 \sigma=0.72 ), and k k -means ( k = 3 k=3 ) clustering. The cluster whose mean embedding has the lower cosine similarity to a generic class-level text prompt (e.g., “a photo of a bird”) is treated as the object segment on datasets where the spurious attribute is expected to be background; the convention is reversed for datasets, such as CelebA, where the spurious attribute is itself part of the foreground. MARS refers to the masking-and-pruning method we study throughout: pixels outside the selected foreground segment are zeroed, and the resulting image is re-encoded with only the top 50% of patch tokens (ranked by foreground-cluster membership) retained.
blocks.zh: 设置. 我们在OpenCLIP ViT-L/14(laion2b_s32b_b82k)上建构,将224×224\times 224的图像标注成16×16 16\times 16格256个补丁符号. 对于给定的图像,我们在补丁嵌入物上使用PCA(3个组件)计算一个前景/背景分区,一个高斯平滑通过所形成的空间网格(= 0.72\西格马= 0.72),以及k-意(k= 3 k= 3)集群. 其平均嵌入值与普通类文本提示值(例如“鸟类照片”)的下等余弦相似的集合,作为数据集上的对象部分,其中假属性为背景;对数据集的常规倒置,例如CelebA,假属性本身是前景的一部分。 MARS指的是我们全程研究的遮盖和冲刷方法:所选前景片段外的像素被零化,产生的图像被重新编码,仅保留了前50%的补丁符号(以前景组成员排名).

blocks.en: Spurious inversion. For each dataset and each foreground/background split, we measure the mean cosine similarity between the general text prompt and (i) the patches assigned to the foreground segment and (ii) the patches assigned to the background segment. On Waterbirds and UrbanCars, background patches have consistently higher text-similarity than foreground patches, across every group (Figure 1 , left). We attribute this to contrastive pretraining on web image-caption pairs, where a background co-occurring reliably with a class label (water for waterbirds, urban scenery for city-registered cars) inflates that background’s alignment with the class prompt in the joint embedding space; the next paragraph makes this account precise. On CelebA, where the spurious attribute (gender) is encoded in the foreground face rather than the background, no such inversion occurs (Figure 1 , right): foreground similarity exceeds background similarity, as expected under a non-inverted regime. Figure 2 walks through this computation end-to-end on two representative images.
blocks.zh: 清净颠倒. 对于每个数据集和每个前景/背景的分割,我们测量一般文本即时和(一)分配给前景段的补丁和(二)分配给背景段的补丁之间的平均余弦相似性. 在Waterbirds和UrbanCars上,背景补丁的文字同义度一直高于前缘补丁,跨越每组(图1,左侧). 我们将此归因于网络图像封装对的对比性预训,在这种预训中,一个背景与一个类标签(水鸟水、城市景色、城市注册汽车)共同可靠地发生,从而夸大了背景与联合嵌入空间中的类提示的一致;下一段使这一说法精确。 在CelebA上,假的属性(性别)被编码在前方面而非背景上,没有出现这样的倒置现象(图1,右):前方相似性超过背景相似性,这是在非倒置制度下预期的. 图2通过两个代表性图像的端到端计算。

blocks.en: Why inversion occurs where it does. A contrastively trained joint embedding aligns an aggregate image representation with its class-level text prompt across the training distribution, and that aggregate depends on both object and background regions. When an object category has substantial visual variation (bird species, body pose, car models) while a co-occurring background is comparatively stable, the background becomes the lower-variance, more consistently label-aligned signal, even though the label is semantically about the object. Background patches can therefore end up more text-aligned than object patches when the spurious attribute is background and the object is heterogeneous, the condition met by Waterbirds and UrbanCars but not CelebA, where the class-relevant signal (gender) sits in a stable facial region. This also predicts the boundary case in Section 5.4 : MetaShifts spreads its spurious attribute over 11 distinct contexts, so no single context is stable enough to reliably outrank the object, a plausible reason SIM’s sign is unreliable there.
blocks.zh: 为什么会发生颠倒。 具有对比性的训练有素的联合嵌入将集成图像表现与整个培训分发过程中的班级文本一致,而集成则取决于对象和背景区域。 当一个物体类别具有实质性的视觉变化(鸟类物种,身体姿势,汽车型号),而一个共同发生背景相对稳定时,背景会变成变异性较低,更一致的标签对应信号,尽管标签对物体有映射性. 因此,当虚假的属性是背景,对象是异性的时,背景补丁最终可以比对象补丁更符合文本,这是水鸟和UrbanCars满足的条件,但不是CelebA,与类相关的信号(性别)坐落在稳定的面部区域. 这也预测了第5.4节中的边界情况: MetaShifts将其虚假属性传播到11个不同的上下文中,因此没有一个单一上下文的稳定程度足以可靠地超过对象,一个可信的理由就是SIM的标志在那里是不可靠的.

blocks.en: Figure 2: The SIM pipeline on two real, representative images (selected as the image within each dataset closest to that dataset’s own mean SIM, not a cherry-picked extreme): original image, the unsupervised foreground/background mask, the per-patch text-similarity heatmap, and the resulting foreground/background means, SIM value, and gate decision. On Waterbirds, background patches (sky, water, wall) outrank the bird itself, giving positive SIM and a MARS decision; on CelebA, the foreground face outranks its surroundings, giving negative SIM and a fallback-to-FastV decision.

blocks.en: A gated deployment policy. SIM’s practical use is as a pre-deployment gate: apply MARS if SIM ⁡ ( D ) > 0 \mathrm{SIM}(D)>0 ; otherwise, fall back to a fixed, non-masking pruning baseline at the same token budget. This policy never processes more than half the tokens a full-resolution forward pass would use, regardless of which branch is taken; the only decision is which compression mechanism to trust for a given deployment target.
blocks.zh: 门将部署政策。 SIM的实际用途是作为部署前的门:如果SIM QQ(D) > 0\mathrm{SIM}(D)>0,应用MARS;否则,返回到一个固定的、非遮盖的基数,在同一标的预算中。 这项政策从不处理超过一半的标语,不管采取哪个分支,一个完全解析的前进通道都会使用;唯一的决定是哪个压缩机制可以信任一个特定的部署目标.

blocks.en: We deliberately choose the simplest policy the data supports. The fallback method is FastV, not an arbitrary choice: Table 1 shows FastV is tied with FiCoCo for the best mean change in worst-group accuracy of any pruning method we evaluate, and markedly faster (12.4ms vs. 15.7ms per image), making it the appropriate default whenever a dataset’s structure does not support masking. The gate itself is a bare sign test, with no fitted threshold or learned classifier: our evidence base is only 8 datasets, and a tuned threshold would overfit a sample this size. Section 5.4 confirms this: a tuned threshold, chosen to correct one dataset’s misclassification, transfers worse across architectures than the parameter-free sign test it was meant to improve on. A learned gate remains a natural extension once more labeled deployment datasets are available.
blocks.zh: 我们有意选择数据支持的最简单政策。 倒置方法为FastV,而非任意选择: 表1显示FastV与 FiCoCo 绑定了我们所评价的最差组别准确性的最佳平均变化,并且明显更快(每幅图像12.4ms对15.7ms),因此当数据集的结构不支持遮掩时,它就成为适当的默认。 门本身是一个赤裸的标志测试,没有安装的阈值或学习过的分类器:我们的证据库只有8个数据集,一个调制的阈值会过度匹配这个大小的样本. 第5.4节证实了这一点:为纠正一个数据集错误的分类而选择的调值阈值,其跨结构的传输比它本打算改进的参数无标志测试更糟糕。 一旦有了贴有标签的部署数据集,一个有学识的大门就仍然是自然延伸。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: Datasets. We evaluate on 8 datasets spanning three structural regimes. Waterbirds [ 4 ] , UrbanCars [ 6 ] , and MetaShifts [ 7 ] have a stable, naturalistically co-occurring background-class correlation (worst-group accuracy over label × \times spurious-attribute groups), where MARS is expected to help. CelebA [ 5 ] has an in-object spurious attribute (gender, in the foreground rather than the background), where masking is expected to hurt. The remaining four lack an exploitable background-class correlation, for different reasons: ImageNet-9 [ 8 ] is background-manipulated, but its group split (original vs. backgrounds swapped in at random from other classes) has no stable co-occurrence for CLIP’s pretraining to have learned, unlike Waterbirds’ or UrbanCars’ naturalistic pairings; OxfordPets [ 13 ] , Caltech101 [ 14 ] , and ImageNet-D [ 15 ] define worst-group accuracy over class identity, not a background split (ImageNet-D’s images are uniformly background-shifted, so no clean-background group exists to compare against). Masking is expected to hurt or be neutral on all four.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们评价8个数据组,涉及3个结构体系。 水鸟[4],UrbanCars[6],和MetaShifts[7]具有稳定,自然共生的背景-类关联性(标签上最差的组精度×\时空假属性组),MARS预计将在此提供帮助. CelebA [5] 具有一个客观的虚假属性(性别,在前缘而非背景),其中面具预期会受到伤害. 其余四人缺乏可开发的背景-阶级关联性,原因不同:ImageNet-9 [8]是背景调节的,但是其群体分裂(原始与背景从其他阶层随机互换)对于CLIP的预训学习没有稳定的共效性,与水鸟或UrbanCars的自然配对不同;OxfordPets [13],Caltech101 [14],以及ImageNet-D [15]定义了最差群体准确度高于阶级身份,而不是背景分裂(ImageNet-D的图像是统一背景转换的,因此不存在可以比较的清洁背景组). 面具会伤害或保持中立

blocks.en: Models. Our primary study uses OpenCLIP ViT-L/14 ( laion2b_s32b_b82k ). Section 5.4 extends this to 6 CLIP variants spanning two independent axes: model size (ViT-B/32, ViT-B/16, ViT-L/14, ViT-H/14) and training data (OpenAI’s original CLIP corpus vs. LAION-2B, held constant in architecture at both ViT-B/32 and ViT-L/14).
blocks.zh: 模特儿们 我们的主要研究使用OpenCLIP ViT-L/14(laion2b_s32b_b82k). 第5.4节将此扩展至6个CLIP变体,跨越两个独立的轴:模型大小(ViT-B/32,ViT-B/16,ViT-L/14,ViT-H/14)和培训数据(OpenAI最初的CLIPuble vs.LAION-2B,在ViT-B/32和ViT-L/14的建筑中均保持不变).

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare against five standard token pruning methods that require no masking: FastV [ 2 ] (attention-based pruning at an intermediate layer), EViT [ 3 ] (attention pruning with token fusion), PatchRank [ 11 ] (multi-layer attention-norm ranking), PACT [ 9 ] (attention pruning with token merging), and FiCoCo [ 10 ] (redundancy-based token filtering), together with a text-guided pruning baseline (ranking tokens by direct text similarity, in the style of SparseVLM [ 12 ] ) that we include specifically because it is the pruning strategy spurious inversion most directly undermines. All pruning baselines and MARS operate at a 50% token budget (128 of 256 tokens) unless noted otherwise.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们比较了五个不需要遮掩的标准代号刷新方法:FastV [2](在中间层基于意向的刷新)、EViT [3](用符号聚变进行意向刷新)、PatchRank [11](多层次的注意-规范排名)、PACT [9](用符号合并进行意向刷新)和FiCoCo [10](基于意向的代号过滤),以及一个文本指导的代号刷新基线(以直接文本相似性排列,在SparseVLM [12]的风格中),我们具体包括这些代号,因为它是最直接破坏的是扭曲的代号策略。 除非另有说明,所有铺设基线和最低运作保障标准的预算为50%(256个指数中的128个)。

blocks.en: Statistical reporting. We report mean ± \pm standard deviation over 3 random seeds for Waterbirds, UrbanCars, and CelebA (full breakdown in Appendix A ). For UrbanCars and CelebA, whose test splits are smaller than the sampled evaluation size, this variation reflects segmentation-algorithm sensitivity rather than resampling variance, so the two are not on the same statistical footing as the rest of the table. All other datasets are evaluated on a single full pass given their larger test splits.

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Compression risk varies by dataset
blocks.zh: 5.1 压缩风险因数据集而异

blocks.en: Table 1 reports each method’s mean relative change in worst-group accuracy vs. the uncompressed baseline, its average accuracy, and its per-image latency, averaged over 8 datasets. Five of six standard baselines carry only mild worst-group risk (within about 7% relative); FastV and FiCoCo mildly improve it on average. Two methods are catastrophic outliers: text-guided pruning (36.7% mean relative loss) and MARS applied without gating (31.6%). Text-guided pruning is riskiest on worst-group accuracy; MARS has the lowest average accuracy of any method: 48.2% vs. 79.9% for the uncompressed baseline, a 38.3% mean per-dataset relative drop (not ( 79.9 − 48.2 ) / 79.9 = 39.7 % (79.9-48.2)/79.9=39.7\% , which applies that formula to the two aggregates directly), the largest drop we observe, showing unconditional masking damages overall usability, not just worst-group robustness. Latency also varies more than attention alone would predict: PACT’s greedy token-merging step is the slowest single-pass method we benchmark, and text-guided pruning’s hidden two-pass structure (score all 256 tokens, then re-encode from scratch with 128) makes it markedly slower than FastV, EViT, PatchRank, and FiCoCo, though still faster than PACT and MARS. MARS remains the slowest method overall (Appendix G ). Unconditionally deploying MARS or text-guided pruning is measurably riskier than deploying no masking-aware compression at all.

blocks.zh: 5.2 SIM预测遮掩的效果

blocks.en: Figure 3 plots SIM against MARS’s actual measured change in worst-group accuracy for all 8 datasets (full per-dataset values in Table 5 of Appendix E ). SIM’s sign correctly predicts the direction of the effect on 7 of 8 datasets. Since this is fundamentally a binary classification of direction rather than a linear relationship, we report an exact one-sided binomial test against a 50% chance baseline: p = 0.035 p=0.035 . This scores ImageNet-D, whose baseline and MARS worst-group accuracy are both exactly 0.0%, as a correct “hurt” prediction, since SIM’s sign is negative there and a non-positive difference is the same directional outcome as a negative one; excluding this degenerate tie entirely gives 6 of 7 datasets and p = 0.063 p=0.063 , not significant at the conventional 0.05 threshold. We report the inclusive figure as primary but flag this sensitivity explicitly; Section 6 returns to it. The Spearman rank correlation between SIM and MARS’s relative change gives ρ = 0.78 \rho=0.78 ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 , t = 2.74 t=2.74 on 5 degrees of freedom, n = 7 n=7 ; ImageNet-D excluded here too, since its relative change is undefined). The one miss, MetaShifts, is analyzed in Section 5.4 and Section 6 , where we show it is a reproducible, structural property of that dataset rather than an isolated artifact.

blocks.en: SIM’s magnitude, not only its sign, carries information about how much a prediction should be trusted. MetaShifts has the smallest magnitude among the three datasets where SIM is positive ( + 0.025 +0.025 , against + 0.044 +0.044 and + 0.051 +0.051 for Waterbirds and UrbanCars), and this smallest-magnitude case is precisely the one that produces the incorrect sign prediction, both here and, as we show next, across every architecture we test. A value of SIM close to zero marks an implicit low-confidence region for the sign test, much like a classifier’s decision boundary. A natural extension is a policy that abstains, or defaults to the safer fallback, when | SIM ⁡ ( D ) | |\mathrm{SIM}(D)| falls below a data-driven margin; constructing and validating such a margin would need a larger collection of datasets than the 8 available to us, and we leave it as a concrete next step.

SIM的值接近零就标志着标志测试的隐含的低信心区域,这与分类者的决定边界非常相似. 自然延伸是指在QQ SIM QQ(D) QQ mathrm{SIM}(D) QQ 低于数据驱动的比值时,放弃或默认为更安全的倒数的政策;构建和验证这样的比值需要比我们可用的8更大的数据集,我们把它留作具体的下一步.

blocks.en: 5.3 Gating recovers masking’s benefit
blocks.zh: 5.3 盖特恢复蒙面的好处

blocks.en: We evaluate the gated policy from Section 3 : apply MARS when SIM ⁡ ( D ) > 0 \mathrm{SIM}(D)>0 , otherwise FastV, at a fixed 128-token budget. Table 2 compares this against always applying MARS (blind) and always applying FastV (blind) across all 8 datasets (Figure 5 , Appendix C ). The gated policy matches or exceeds blind MARS on every dataset by construction, and matches FastV exactly whenever it correctly abstains from masking, 7 of 8 datasets. The one exception: on MetaShifts, the gate follows SIM’s incorrect positive sign and selects MARS, scoring 52.2% against the 87.8% blind FastV would have achieved, a 40.5% relative deficit: the direct practical cost of the diagnostic’s one structural blind spot (Section 5.2 ), and why the gate’s mean (49.4%) sits slightly below blind FastV’s mean (51.1%). The gate strictly improves only over always running MARS blindly, not over FastV; Section 6 treats this as a central finding, not a footnote.
blocks.zh: 我们从第3节来评价门面政策:当SIM QQ(D) > 0\mathrm{SIM}(D)>0,否则FastV, 在一个固定的128位预算时适用MARS。 表2将这一点与始终应用MARS(盲)和始终在所有8个数据集应用FastV(盲)相比较(图5,附录C)。 闸门政策在构造的每个数据集上匹配或超过盲点的MARS,在正确避免遮掩时精确匹配FastV,8个数据集中的7个. 其中一个例外:在MetaShifts上,大门遵循了SIM的错误正号并选择了MARS, 与87.8%的盲人快车相比得分为52.2%, 相对赤字为40.5%:诊断器一个结构盲点的直接实际成本(第5.2节), 大门的平均值(49.4%)为何略低于盲人快车的平均值(51.1%)。 大门严格改善的只是总是盲目运行的MARS,而不是FastV;第6节将此作为中心发现,而不是脚注.

blocks.en: The right way to read this comparison is bounding risk under uncertainty about the deployment target, not maximizing mean accuracy. A practitioner who does not know whether a new dataset resembles Waterbirds and UrbanCars, where blind FastV forfeits 11.9% and 35.0% of MARS’s worst-group accuracy, or MetaShifts, where blind MARS risks a 39.7% relative loss, faces a genuine bet either way. The gate removes the need to make that bet blindly: its known downside is a 40.5% relative loss on one dataset out of eight, bounded by the structural condition in Section 5.4 , not unbounded exposure to whichever failure mode a new target triggers.
blocks.zh: 阅读这一比较的正确方式是在部署目标的不确定性下形成风险的界限,而不是最大限度地提高平均准确性。 一个不知道新数据集是否类似于Waterbirds和UrbanCars的从业者,盲快V丧失了MARS最差组的11.9%和35.0%的精度,或者MetaShifts,盲快MARS冒着39.7%的相对损失风险,无论是哪种方式都面临真正的赌注。 该门取消了盲目下注的必要性:它已知的下限是8个数据集的40.5%的相对损失,以第5.4节的结构条件为界,而不是无限制地暴露在任何故障模式下的新目标触发器上.

blocks.en: This evaluation is a sign test with no free parameter: no threshold was tuned on this table. An earlier version used a small positive margin (threshold 0.03 0.03 ) to additionally correct the MetaShifts case, but Section 5.4 shows this margin does not transfer across architectures as reliably as the parameter-free sign test. We therefore report the sign-test result, the version of the claim we can defend across the full range of models evaluated.
blocks.zh: 这个评价是一个没有自由参数的标志性测试:本表中没有调整阈值. 早期的版本使用小正差(门槛为0.03 0.03)来额外校正MetaShifts案例,但第5.4节显示这一比值不会像参数免签测试那样可靠地跨架构转移. 因此,我们报告签字测试结果,即我们可以在所评价的所有模型中捍卫的说法。

blocks.en: 5.4 Generalization across architectures
blocks.zh: 5.4 跨结构的概括

blocks.en: A diagnostic validated on a single checkpoint is of limited practical use. We extend the sign-test evaluation to 6 CLIP variants: ViT-B/32 and ViT-L/14 each under both OpenAI and LAION-2B pretraining (isolating the training-data axis at matched architecture), ViT-B/16, and ViT-H/14 (extending the capacity axis), evaluated across all 8 datasets, for 48 (architecture, dataset) combinations in total.
blocks.zh: 在单一检查站验证的诊断方法实际上用处有限。 我们在OpenAI和LAION-2B(将培训-数据轴隔离在匹配的架构下)、Vit-B/16和Vit-H/14(排除容量轴)的预训下,对所有8个数据集进行了总共48个组合的评价。

blocks.en: The sign test is correct on 31 of 48 combinations (64.6%; exact binomial p = 0.030 p=0.030 ). These 48 trials are not independent: they are 8 datasets repeated across 6 architectures, and a dataset’s outcome is correlated across architectures (MetaShifts contributes 6 dependent failures, not 6 independent ones), so the effective sample size is closer to 8 than 48. Figure 4 (Appendix B ) visualizes the pattern, concentrated rather than noisy. Five of the six architectures are correct on all three datasets the diagnostic was designed around (Waterbirds, UrbanCars, CelebA); the sixth (ViT-H/14, LAION) misses only Waterbirds. MetaShifts is incorrect for all 6 architectures without exception, an architecture-independent property of its subtler, multi-context spurious attribute (11 scene contexts, not one background category). A smaller number of misses occur on the fine-grained benchmarks (OxfordPets, Caltech101, ImageNet-D), several coinciding with both methods collapsing to near-zero accuracy regardless of the gate’s decision, a separate phenomenon from spurious inversion.
blocks.zh: 48种组合中的31种(64.6%;准确的二进制p=0.030 p=0.030)的标志测试是正确的. 这48项试验不独立:它们是6个架构重复的8个数据集,一个数据集的结果在架构之间相互关联(MetaShifts贡献了6个依赖性的失败,而不是6个独立的失败),所以有效的样本大小接近8比48. 图4(附录B)可视化图案,集中而非吵闹. 6个建筑中有5个在所有3个数据集上都是正确的,诊断是围绕这3个数据集设计的(Waterbirds,UrbanCars,CelebA);第6个(ViT-H/14,LAION)只错过了Waterbirds. MetaShifts对所有6个架构无一例外都是不正确的,这是其微妙,多文字的虚假属性(11场景背景,而非一个背景类)的架构独立属性. 在精细的衡量标准(OxfordPets、Caltech101、ImageNet-D)上出现少部分缺失,其中几种方法不考虑大门的决定,都崩溃到接近于零的准确度,这是与虚假的倒置现象不同的现象。

blocks.en: Notably, ViT-L/14 under LAION-2B and OpenAI pretraining achieve closely comparable correctness at matched architecture: 6/8 and 5/8, respectively, differing only on Caltech101, a fine-grained benchmark already identified above as a separate failure mode. This indicates that spurious inversion is a property of contrastive image-text pretraining broadly, not an artifact specific to the LAION-2B corpus. We also verify that the margin used in Table 2 ’s development (threshold 0.03 0.03 ) does not outperform the parameter-free sign test once evaluated across architectures: both achieve exactly 31/48. This is the reason we report the sign test, not a tuned threshold, as our primary claim throughout this paper.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,LAION-2B和OpenAI预训下的VIT-L/14在匹配架构上分别实现了高度相似的正确性:6/8和5/8,仅在Caltech101上不同,Caltech101是上面已经确定为单独故障模式的精细标本. 这表明,假反演是一种具有对比性的图像文本预先广泛训练的财产,而不是LAION-2Bax特有文物。 我们还证实,表2的开发(阈值0.03 0.03)中使用的比值在跨架构评估后没有超过参数无标志测试:两者都完全达到31/48。 这就是为什么我们报告标志测试,而不是一个调制的门槛,作为我们在整个本文中的主要主张。

blocks.en: 5.5 Two distinct costs: offline vs. per-inference
blocks.zh: 5.5 导弹 两种不同的费用:离线相对于推论

blocks.en: A compression pipeline built around SIM incurs two costs at different points in the deployment lifecycle. SIM is a dataset-level quantity : computing it requires sampling a modest number of images from the target deployment distribution once, before any inference-time decision is made, so its cost is a fixed, one-time overhead amortized to zero over the deployment’s lifetime. MARS’s own masking step is different : whenever the gate selects MARS, every subsequent image still requires its own foreground/background segmentation, since the mask is specific to that image’s content, not to the dataset as a whole.
blocks.zh: 围绕SIM建造的压缩管道在部署寿命周期的不同阶段需要两个费用。 SIM是一个数据集级别的数量 : 计算需要从目标部署分布中抽取少量图像,在作出任何推断时间的决定之前一次,因此其成本是固定的一次性间接费用,在部署期间摊还到零。 MARS自己的面具步骤不同: 每当门选择MARS时,每个后续的图像仍然需要自己的前景/背景分割,因为面具是针对该图像的内容,而不是整个数据集的.

blocks.en: Full per-stage latency is reported in Table 7 of Appendix G . One detail matters for reading MARS’s cost correctly: the patch embeddings that feed PCA and k k -means must be the contextualized output of the full vision transformer (Section 3 ), requiring one full, unpruned 256-token forward pass before segmentation can begin; MARS’s masked, pruned re-encoding at 128 tokens is a second forward pass on top of that. Summing all three stages, MARS’s true per-image cost is ≈ \approx 15.7ms + 28.5ms (CPU segmentation) + 11.0ms ≈ \approx 55.2ms, roughly 3.5 × \times the 15.7ms baseline. FastV incurs no such first pass, since it prunes from attention weights already computed inside its single forward pass, for a complete one-pass cost of 12.4ms.
blocks.zh: 附录G表7报告了每个阶段的全部延迟情况。 用于正确阅读MARS成本的一个细节事项是: 给PCA 和 kk - 意思的补丁嵌入必须是全视觉变压器的上下文输出(第3节 ) , 需要一个完整的,未插孔的256个前传才能开始分割; MARS的蒙面, 刷孔重编码在128个令牌上是第二个前传。 总结所有三个阶段,MARS真实的每幅图像成本为 \\\ 大约15.7ms + 28.5ms(CPU 分割) + 11.0ms → 大约55.2ms,大约3.5×\ 时间为15.7ms的基准. 快点 V没有这种第一次通行证,因为它从单个前方通行证中已经计算的注意力重量中抽取,完全一次性通行证费用为12.4毫秒。

blocks.en: We investigated three independent routes to reducing this segmentation cost; two did not succeed. Appendix H reports both in full: a single-image GPU reimplementation, which was slower than the CPU path it targeted (161ms/image vs. 28.5ms) and less faithful to it (65% mask IoU), and an attention-based diagnostic that showed no dataset-discriminative signal at all.
blocks.zh: 我们调查了三条独立路线,以减少这种分割费用;两条路线没有成功。 附录H既完整地报告:单图像的GPU重置,比它所瞄准的CPU路径(161ms/image vs 28.5ms)慢,也不太忠实(65%的口罩IoU),基于注意力的诊断显示完全没有数据集-歧化信号.

blocks.en: The third route succeeded. Profiling the single-image GPU attempt’s k k -means step revealed the real problem: its initialization and convergence check called .item() and .cpu() every iteration, a host-device synchronization that idles the GPU once per image. We removed every such call and batched PCA-and- k k -means across many images in one vectorized call. This reduces segmentation cost to 0.81ms/image at batch size 128, a 35 × 35\times reduction from the CPU path. We validated this before trusting it: on 300 held-out images each from Waterbirds, UrbanCars, and CelebA, its worst-group accuracy matched or exceeded the CPU reference on all three (full sweep in Appendix H ). With this fix, MARS’s true per-image cost falls to ≈ \approx 27.5ms, roughly 1.75 × \times baseline, about half the original 3.5 × \times gap. We also tried reusing one fixed PCA basis across a dataset rather than refitting it per image; this is faster still (0.14ms/image) but less accurate and consistent ( − 9.4 % -9.4\% to + 21.8 % +21.8\% relative, vs. the per-image variant’s 0.0 % 0.0\% to + 6.5 % +6.5\% ), so we report the per-image-adaptive result as our validated finding.
blocks.zh: 第三条路线成功. 剖析单图像 GPU 尝试的 k k - 意思是步骤 揭示了真正的问题: 它的初始化和趋同检查称为. item () 和. cpu () 每个迭代,一个主机-设备同步,每个图像闲置一次 GPU 。 我们删除了每一次这样的呼叫, 分批的PCA -和K -K -意思是在许多图像上 一个矢量的呼叫。 这使得在批量尺寸128时的分割成本降低到0.81ms/image,比CPU路径减少35×35\时间. 我们在信任它之前验证了这一点:在水鸟、UrbanCars和CelebA的300张被搁置的图像上,它最差的组的准确度与所有三个组的CPU参考值相匹配或超过(附录H中的全扫描)。 MARS真实的每幅图像成本跌至约27.5ms, 我们还尝试在一个数据集中重新使用一个固定的PCA基数,而不是每个图像重排;这个基数速度更快(0.14ms/image),但不太准确和一致(-9.4%-9.4++21.8+++21.8++======================================================================================================================================================================================================

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6 讨论和限制

blocks.en: Where the diagnostic is reliable. SIM’s sign is dependable on datasets whose spurious attribute is a spatially coherent, separable region: background scenery, in our benchmarks. Section 5.4 shows near-perfect sign-agreement on the three datasets with this property (Waterbirds, UrbanCars, CelebA: 17 of 18 correct across 6 architectures), in sharp contrast to its one systematic failure (MetaShifts, incorrect for all 6 architectures), whose spurious attribute (11 distinct scene contexts) does not fit this description. This boundary is a contribution in its own right: it names the condition under which the diagnostic can be expected to work.
blocks.zh: 在诊断可靠的地方 SIM的标志依赖于数据集,其虚伪的属性是一个空间连贯,可分离的区域:背景景色,在我们的基准中. 第5.4节显示了与这个属性的三套数据集(Waterbirds,UrbanCars,CelebA:18个中的17个正确跨6个架构)的近乎完美的标志协议,与它的系统故障(MetaShifts,所有6个架构都不正确)形成鲜明对比,其虚假属性(11个不同的场景背景)不符合这一描述. 这个界限本身就是一个贡献:它说明了可以期望诊断起作用的条件.

blocks.en: Group-stratified sampling is not essential. Our main results compute SIM from samples stratified across each benchmark’s existing groups, a weaker requirement than the labeled evaluation it replaces, but not the same as a fully unlabeled pool. A flat, unstratified pool of 200 images per dataset, with no group indexing at all (Appendix F ), achieves the same 7 of 8 correct sign predictions, agreeing with the stratified version on all 8 datasets. This is reasonably strong, though not exhaustive, evidence that SIM’s practical requirement is a representative unlabeled sample, not knowledge of group structure.
blocks.zh: 分组抽样并不重要。 我们的主要结果从每个基准现有组的样本中计算出SIM,这个要求比它所取代的标注评价要弱,但与完全无标注的集合不同。 每个数据集200个图像的平坦,未分级的集合,完全没有分组索引(Appendix F ),实现8个正确标志预测中的相同7个,同意所有8个数据集的分级版本. 这是相当有力的证据,虽然不是详尽无遗的,表明SIM的实际要求是一个没有标签的代表性样本,而不是对群体结构的了解。

blocks.en: The sign test rests on 8 datasets. The headline binomial result (7 of 8 correct, p = 0.035 p=0.035 ) is not robust to the small sample it is computed over, and this is not merely a hypothetical concern about future data: Section 5.2 shows it already hinges on how ImageNet-D’s degenerate 0-vs-0 tie is scored, with the excluded-tie alternative (6 of 7, p = 0.063 p=0.063 ) crossing the conventional significance threshold. We corroborate the inclusive result with the architecture-generalization sweep (Section 5.4 ) and the Spearman correlation, both pointing the same direction, but none of these substitutes for a larger and more diverse collection of benchmark datasets than the field currently offers for this problem.
blocks.zh: 标志测试基于8个数据集. 头条二进制结果(8分之7正确,p = 0.035 p = 0.035)对它所计算的小样本并不健全,这不仅仅是对未来数据的假设性关注:第5.2节显示,它已经取决于ImageNet-D的堕落的0-vs-0领带如何得分,被排除的领带替代品(7分之6,p = 0.063 p = 0.063)超越了常规意义阈值. 我们用架构通俗化扫描(第5.4节)和斯皮尔曼关联来证实包容性结果,两者都指向了同样的方向,但这些替代收集基准数据集的更大、更多样化的数据集都没有比目前该领域为这一问题提供的数据集。

blocks.en: Validation is retrospective. Every result here checks SIM’s prediction against a worst-group accuracy measurement we already had. A genuinely prospective test, committing to a prediction before any labeled evaluation exists and then measuring the outcome, is the appropriate next step; we attempted this using two additional benchmarks (Spawrious and CounterAnimal), never used to develop SIM, but neither was available in a usable state on our compute infrastructure in time for this submission.
blocks.zh: 验证是追溯性的。 每一个结果都检查SIM的预测, 下一个适当步骤是进行真正的预期试验,承诺在任何标注的评价存在之前作出预测,然后衡量结果;我们试图利用两个额外的基准(Spawrious and anthanimal)来进行这种试验,从未用于开发SIM,但在本次提交之前,我们的计算基础设施也没有可用的状态。

blocks.en: Efficiency: improved, not resolved. Section 5.5 found MARS’s segmentation cost initially brought its total latency to roughly 3.5 × \times baseline; a batched, synchronization-free GPU reimplementation reduces this to roughly 1.75 × \times , validated for worst-group-accuracy parity across three datasets (Appendix H ). The remaining gap follows from MARS’s design, not an inherent limit of masking-based compression: it masks pixels and re-encodes from scratch, needing two full forward passes regardless of segmentation speed, whereas FastV and EViT prune from an intermediate layer’s activations and continue the same pass with fewer tokens. A redesign that segments from intermediate-layer activations within a single pass, rather than re-encoding from the input, is untested here and would plausibly close most of the gap; we leave it to future work.
blocks.zh: 效率:改善,未解决。 第5.5节认为,MARS的分解成本最初使其总延迟度达到大约3.5×\时基线;经过批量的、无同步的GPU重施将这一成本降低到大约1.75×\时,并被验证为三个数据集最差的组-精确度等值(附录H)。 其余的空白来自MARS的设计,而不是基于面具的压缩的内在限制:它从零开始遮掩像素和重新编码,无论分区速度如何,都需要两个完整的前行通行证,而FastV和EViT prune则来自中间层的激活,并以更少的代号继续同样的通行证. 一个从中间层激活到一个通道的段段的重新设计,而不是从输入中重新编码,是在这里没有经过试验的,并且可以合理地弥补大部分差距;我们把它留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: Broader impacts. This work’s main contribution, a diagnostic that flags in advance when masking-based compression will hurt worst-group robustness, is intended to reduce the risk of silently deploying a compressed CLIP-style model that performs worse for a minority subgroup, a failure mode with direct fairness implications. We also see a specific misuse risk: SIM has a documented blind spot (MetaShifts) and is validated on only 8 datasets, so treating a positive SIM-gated decision as a general safety certificate, rather than evidence bounded by the conditions we identify, would misuse it. All datasets used are existing, standard academic benchmarks; we introduce no new datasets, pretrained models, or public releases carrying an independent misuse risk.
blocks.zh: 更大的影响。 这部作品的主要贡献是,在基于面具的压缩会伤害最坏组的稳健性时提前标出旗号的诊断,旨在降低默默部署压缩的CLIP式模型的风险,这种模型对少数组来说表现更糟糕,这种失败模式具有直接的公平性影响. 我们还看到具体的滥用风险:SIM有一个有文件记载的盲点(MetaShifts),并且只在8个数据集上验证,因此,将SIM的正面决定作为一般安全证明,而不是以我们确定的条件为界限的证据,会滥用它。 所有使用的数据集都是现有的标准学术基准;我们没有引入新的数据集,没有经过预先培训的模型,也没有引入具有独立滥用风险的公开发布.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We show that a widely plausible assumption, that masking spurious background context improves both the robustness and the efficiency of a compressed CLIP-style model, holds only conditionally, and that its failure mode is invisible without a diagnostic. Spurious inversion gives a mechanistic account of why standard importance signals point the wrong way on certain datasets, and SIM turns this account into a measurement a practitioner can take before deployment, with a statistically supported and architecture-tested claim about when it can be trusted. We view the precise characterization of where this diagnostic holds, together with a clear accounting of what remains computationally unsolved, as the appropriate empirical contribution of a paper whose subject is when to trust a compression method, not merely whether one particular method is best.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,一个非常可信的假设,即掩盖虚假的背景环境既能提高压缩的CLIP型模型的稳健性和效率,又能有条件地维持,其失败模式在不经过诊断的情况下是看不见的。 纯粹的反演给出了一个机械化的描述,说明标准重要性信号为何在某些数据集上指错方向,而SIM将这个记号变成一个从业者在部署前可以采取的测量方法,在统计学上支持并经过架构测试的关于何时可以信任的说法. 我们认为,对这一诊断的准确定性,以及对在计算上仍未解决的问题的明确解释,是一份论文的适当经验性贡献,其主题是何时相信压缩方法,而不仅仅是某一方法是否最好。

blocks.en: We additionally ablate three components of the MARS pipeline on Waterbirds and UrbanCars: the token-keep ratio (10–90%), the number of k k -means clusters ( k ∈ { 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 } k\in\{2,3,4,5\} ), and the Gaussian smoothing bandwidth ( σ ∈ { 0 , 0.5 , 0.72 , 1.0 , 1.5 , 2.0 } \sigma\in\{0,0.5,0.72,1.0,1.5,2.0\} ). A 33% keep ratio modestly outperforms this sweep’s own single-seed 50%-ratio run (67.2% vs. 65.6% worst-group accuracy on Waterbirds; the main paper’s 3-seed mean at 50% is 67.3 ± 2.7 67.3\pm 2.7 , Table 3 , consistent with this single-seed value). Neither k = 3 k=3 nor σ = 0.72 \sigma=0.72 , the defaults used throughout the paper, is optimal in this sweep: k = 5 k=5 reaches 45.6% worst-group accuracy on UrbanCars against k = 3 k=3 ’s 38.4%, and σ = 1.0 \sigma=1.0 modestly exceeds σ = 0.72 \sigma=0.72 on both datasets (68.8% vs. 65.6% on Waterbirds; 40.3% vs. 38.4% on UrbanCars). This sweep’s own UrbanCars default-config run (38.4%) sits just below the main paper’s 3-seed range for the same configuration ( 40.3 ± 1.0 40.3\pm 1.0 , Table 3 ); Section 4 already attributes UrbanCars’ run-to-run variation to the k k -means segmentation step’s own seed sensitivity rather than resampling, which is consistent with a separately-run single-seed sweep landing just outside that range. We did not retune k k or σ \sigma post hoc based on this sweep; both remain fixed at the values used throughout the rest of the paper. This shows the method is not highly sensitive to the token-keep ratio within a reasonable range, though k k and σ \sigma do leave some accuracy on the table at their current defaults.

blocks.en: We further ablate the masking fill strategy: zeroing vs. mean-fill, blur-fill, and grayscale-fill. We test it on all four datasets now available to us. On the two where masking helps (Waterbirds, UrbanCars), all strategies other than grayscale-fill perform comparably. This suggests the mechanism here is the removal of background information, not the specific replacement value. On the two where masking hurts (CelebA, ImageNet-9), the result is both more consequential and more mixed. On CelebA, replacing zero-fill with grayscale-fill closes nearly all of MARS’s downside risk: worst-group accuracy moves from 17.0 % 17.0\% relative below that run’s own uncompressed baseline under zero-fill, to 5.9 % 5.9\% relative above it under grayscale-fill. On ImageNet-9, the same substitution helps, but far less completely: it cuts the relative damage from 63.2 % 63.2\% below baseline to 50.4 % 50.4\% below it, still a severe failure. Fill strategy is therefore not a general fix for masking’s downside risk. It substantially mitigates the risk on one of our two masking-hurts datasets, and only partially on the other. We report this as a genuine, dataset-dependent finding, complementary to, not a substitute for, the SIM-gated policy this paper’s main results are built around.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步降低遮盖填充策略:零填充与平均填充,模糊填充,灰色填充。 我们用所有四个数据集测试它 在蒙面帮助的两个方面(Waterbirds, UrbanCars),除灰度填充外,所有策略都具有类似的性能. 这表明此处的机制是删除背景资料,而不是具体的替换值。 在面具伤害(CelebA,ImageNet-9)的两个方面,结果既有结果,也有结果。 在CelebA上,用灰度填充取代零填充几乎关闭了MARS的所有下限风险:最差组的精度从17.0%的17.0======================================================================================================================================================================================================================= 在ImageNet-9上,同样的替代帮助了,但更不完全:它将相对损害从低于基线的63.2% 63.2\%减少到低于基线的50.4% 50.4\%,仍然是严重的失败. 因此,填充策略并不是遮掩负面风险的一般解决办法。 它大大减轻了我们两个掩蔽-创伤数据集之一的风险,而另一个只是部分风险。 我们报告这是一个真实的、依赖数据集的发现,它补充而不是取代了本文主要成果所依据的SIM政策。

blocks.en: GPU-resident segmentation, single-image (unsuccessful). We reimplemented the PCA, Gaussian smoothing, and k k -means steps to run entirely on GPU (via low-rank PCA, a depthwise-convolution Gaussian blur, and a vectorized Lloyd’s-algorithm k k -means), removing the CPU round-trip present in the original scikit-learn-based implementation. On a 48-image validation processed one image at a time (batch size 1), the GPU implementation was slower in wall-clock terms than the CPU path (161ms/image, against the 28.5ms/image CPU figure reported in Table 7 ) and less faithful to it (65% mask IoU agreement, 58.3% vs. 41.7% resulting worst-group accuracy). At the time, we attributed the slowdown to kernel-launch overhead dominating at this problem size (256 points, 3 clusters) and flagged batching, untested at the time, as the most direct plausible mitigation. The following paragraph reports that follow-up experiment.
blocks.zh: GPU-居民分割,单像(不成功). 我们重新执行CPA、Gaussian平滑和k-k步骤来完全运行在GPU上(通过低级的CPA、深智的Gaussian模糊,以及矢量化的Lloyd的algorithm k-k-mans),删除了原始的scikit-learn执行中的CPU圆路面。 在48图像验证一次处理一个图像(批量尺寸1)时,GPU的墙钟执行速度慢于CPU路径(161ms/image,相对于表7中报告的28.5ms/image CPU数字),对它不忠实(65%的面具IoU协议,58.3%对41.7%导致最差组的准确性). 当时,我们把减缓归因于内核发射在这种问题规模(256点,3组)上占据主导地位,并且标出当时未经测试的批量,作为最直接的可行缓解。 以下段落报告了后续试验。

blocks.en: Batched, synchronization-free GPU segmentation (successful). Profiling the single-image attempt above more closely than we had for the result reported a paragraph above, we found the actual bottleneck was more specific than generic kernel-launch overhead: its k k -means initialization and convergence check called .item() and .cpu() on every iteration, each forcing a host-device synchronization that idles the GPU and hands control back to Python once per image. We rewrote k k -means initialization and the Lloyd iteration to use only batched, GPU-resident tensor operations ( torch.multinomial for k k -means++ sampling across the whole batch at once, and a fixed iteration count in place of a per-iteration torch.allclose convergence check), and batched PCA fitting across images via torch.pca_lowrank ’s native batch support, so that an entire batch of images is segmented in one sequence of vectorized calls rather than one Python-level call per image.

blocks.en: Table 8 reports the resulting per-image segmentation cost as a function of batch size. It also reports a variant that reuses one fixed PCA basis, fit once on a calibration sample per dataset, instead of fitting PCA per image. Table 9 reports the correctness validation we ran before trusting either number, on 300 held-out images each from Waterbirds, UrbanCars, and CelebA. Worst-group accuracy under the per-image-adaptive batched variant matched or exceeded the CPU reference on all three datasets. Its mask IoU sits in the same 0.6–0.68 range as the original, unsuccessful single-image GPU attempt’s 65%. This tells us the batched rewrite inherits the same known approximation gap against the sklearn reference, rather than introducing a new one, and that this level of patch-level disagreement does not cost worst-group accuracy. The shared-PCA-basis variant is faster still, but its accuracy is less consistent: it varies from − 9.4 % -9.4\% to + 21.8 % +21.8\% relative across the three datasets, against the per-image variant’s 0.0 % 0.0\% to + 6.5 % +6.5\% . We therefore do not report it as a validated result, and flag it instead as a promising direction that needs further validation. We also note that the shared-basis variant’s batch-128 measurement showed a standard deviation exceeding its own mean, an intermittent instability. Diagnosing and resolving it is a natural next step for future work; for now, we treat this specific batch-size number as an open question rather than a result to trust.

blocks.en: Attention-based diagnostic. We tested whether CLS attention, already computed within a single required forward pass, could replace the segmentation step entirely as the basis for a SIM-like diagnostic, using two candidate formulations: (i) the difference in text-similarity between low- and high-attention patches, and (ii) the raw correlation between per-patch attention weight and per-patch text-similarity. Evaluated against the known ground-truth direction on 5 datasets, both formulations returned a constant sign across every dataset (uniformly positive for (i), uniformly negative for (ii)), indicating neither captures dataset-specific spurious structure; both are more consistent with a generic property of CLIP’s attention (plausibly related to documented “attention sink” effects in vision transformers) than with the phenomenon SIM is designed to measure.
blocks.zh: 专注诊断. 我们用两种候选配方来测试已经用一个所需前传的单段计算出的CLS注意力能否完全取代分化步骤,作为类似SIM的诊断的基础:(一) 低注意力补丁和高注意力补丁在文本相似性上的区别;(二) 每幅注意力重量与每幅文字相似性之间的原始相关性。 根据5个数据集已知的地面-真实方向来评价,两个配方都返回了每个数据集的恒定符号(对(一)统一为正,对(二)统一为负),表明两个数据集都没有捕捉到数据集特有的虚假结构;两者都比SIM设计用来测量的现象更符合CLIP的注意的通用属性(与视觉变压器中记录的 " 注意沉积 " 效应有关)。
